# tplink_port_forwards (Data Source)

All port forwarding (virtual server) rules configured on the router.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "tplink_port_forwards" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `rules` (Attributes Set) Configured rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active.
- `external_port` (String) WAN-side port or start-end range.
- `internal_port` (String) LAN-side port.
- `ip` (String) Internal (LAN) address the rule forwards to.
- `name` (String) Rule name (unique).
- `protocol` (String) TCP, UDP or ALL.
